definitions.explanation: Hair braided and hanging down, typically in two braids on each side of the head. Most commonly associated with girls' hairstyles.

examples.japanese: おさげ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{女|おんな}の{子|こ}→女の子：02865_onnanoko⟧。

examples.english: To wear one's hair in braids.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小学生|しょうがくせい}→小学生：03069_shougakusei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧、⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧おさげ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{編|あ}んで→編む：00002_amu⟧⟦もらっていた→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: When I was in elementary school, my mother braided my hair every morning.

notes:
From お⟦{下|さ}げ→下げる：00807_sageru⟧, literally "hanging down" with the honorific prefix お. Originally referred to any hair hanging down the back, but now specifically means braided pigtails.

USAGE:
Strongly associated with young girls, especially schoolgirls. The image of おさげ evokes childhood and innocence in Japanese culture. Also called ⟦{三|み}つ{編|あ}み→三つ編み：18439_mitsuami⟧ (three-strand braid) when referring to the braiding technique itself.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- おさげ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{女|おんな}の{子|こ}→女の子：02865_onnanoko⟧ — a girl with braids
- おさげ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to wear in braids
- おさげ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{編|あ}む→編む：00002_amu⟧ — to braid pigtails
- おさげ{髪|がみ} — braided hair

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{三|み}つ{編|あ}み→三つ編み：18439_mitsuami⟧ — braid, plait; refers to the braiding technique
- ツインテール — twin tails; ponytails on each side (not braided)
- ⟦ポニーテール→ポニーテール：20944_poniiteeru⟧ — ponytail; a single tail at the back
